title: Add and subtract decimals

hints.dec.add-sub.line-up: Line up the decimal points, not the last digits. Fill in zeros so both have the same number of places.
hints.dec.add-sub.whole-numbers: A whole number has its point at the end: 6 = 6.00. Line up the points, then subtract, borrowing as usual.
hints.dec.add-sub: Line up the points, fill in zeros, then add or subtract column by column. The point goes straight down.

misconceptionMessages.dec.right-align: Line up the decimal points, not the last digits. Tenths go under tenths: 3.50 + 1.25.
misconceptionMessages.dec.whole-ignored: Write the whole number with zeros after the point (6 = 6.00), line up the points, and subtract every column. You'll need to borrow.

similarProblemIntro: Here's the worked solution. Now try one like it.

sections.title: Line up the points
sections.objective: Add and subtract decimals with different numbers of places.
explain: Ones under ones, tenths under tenths. Lining up the points does that for you.
Then it works just like whole numbers, carrying and borrowing as usual.

visual.caption: 3.5 + 1.25, one column at a time. The grey 0 is filled in.

sections.key: Line up the decimal points, not the last digits. Fill in zeros so both have the same number of places. The point in the answer goes straight down.

sections.title: A whole number and a decimal
sections.objective: Add and subtract when one number is a whole number (6 − 2.35).
explain: A whole number's point is at the end: 6 is 6. or 6.00.
Subtract every column. The zeros mean borrowing.

visual.caption: 6 − 2.35: write 6 as 6.00, then borrow across the zeros.

sections.key: A whole number has its point at the end: 6 = 6.00. Line up the points, then subtract every column, borrowing across the zeros.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Add and subtract decimals of every kind.
sections.key: Line up the points, fill in zeros, then work column by column. The point goes straight down.
